Israel launches new ground operation in central Gaza

Israel has launched a new ground operation in central Gaza, with dozens reported to be fleeing the area. This development follows an International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling concerning genocide in Myanmar, which has raised new legal challenges for Israel. The operation involves a new military endeavor in Gaza.
